# Vichar

> Vichar is an open-source AI gateway. Route requests through one OpenAI-compatible API and key, with usage analytics, cost tracking, caching, and automatic failover. The live models and providers directories list current availability. Open source (AGPLv3) and self-hostable.

## Key pages

- [Models](https://app.vichar.io/models): Full catalog of supported LLMs with pricing, context windows, and capabilities.
- [LLM Rankings](https://app.vichar.io/rankings): Which models developers actually run in production — live token volume, trends, and provider market share over 24h/7d/30d windows.
- [Model release timeline](https://app.vichar.io/timeline): When each LLM was released by its provider and when it was added to Vichar — a reference for AI model release dates.
- [Pricing](https://app.vichar.io/pricing): Per-token at provider rates. Pay-as-you-go credits carry a flat 5% platform fee; Bring-Your-Own-Keys is free; enterprise plans available.
- [Pricing (machine-readable)](https://app.vichar.io/pricing.md): Plain-markdown pricing summary for AI agents.
- [Providers](https://app.vichar.io/providers): Every supported provider and the models each offers.
- [Docs](https://docs.vichar.io): API reference and integration guides.
- [About](https://app.vichar.io/about): Who builds Vichar and why.
- [Contact](https://app.vichar.io/contact): Email, Discord, GitHub, and enterprise sales channels.
- [Compare](https://app.vichar.io/compare/open-router): How Vichar compares to OpenRouter, LiteLLM, Portkey, the Vercel AI Gateway, and GitHub Copilot.
- [GitHub Copilot cost calculator](https://app.vichar.io/copilot-cost-calculator): Estimate a team's monthly Copilot AI Credits bill under the June 2026 usage-based billing and compare the same workload at pass-through token prices with prompt caching.
- [Migrate from GitHub Copilot](https://app.vichar.io/migration/github-copilot): Map Copilot chat, agent mode, and code review to gateway-backed tools with hard budget caps.
- [Migrate from OpenRouter](https://app.vichar.io/migration/openrouter): Same OpenAI-compatible API and model strings — swap the base URL and key, keep BYOK free, and self-host if you need prompts inside your own network.

## Best models by use case

- [Best models for roleplay](https://app.vichar.io/models/roleplay): Roleplay and character-chat LLMs compared by prose quality, context window, and price.
- [Best models for coding](https://app.vichar.io/models/coding): Code generation and agentic coding models, frontier and open-weight.
- [Best models for creative writing](https://app.vichar.io/models/creative-writing): LLMs with strong long-form prose and narrative consistency.
- [Best models for translation](https://app.vichar.io/models/translation): Multilingual models for document and string translation.
- [Best models for math](https://app.vichar.io/models/math): Reasoning models for competition math and quantitative work.
- [Long context models](https://app.vichar.io/models/long-context): Models with 200K to 2M token context windows.
- [Cheapest models](https://app.vichar.io/models/cheapest): Models at or under $0.20 per million input tokens.
- [Open source models](https://app.vichar.io/models/open-source): Open-weight LLMs served via API, with current pricing and capabilities.

## Developer resources

- [Vichar developer resources](https://app.vichar.io/developers): API documentation, authentication, developer dashboard, and MCP entry points.
- [Vichar authentication](https://docs.vichar.io/features/api-keys): Create, rotate, and scope API keys; authenticate with the Authorization: Bearer header.
- [Vichar developer dashboard](https://app.vichar.io/dashboard): Sign in to manage projects, keys, usage, and spending limits.
- [Vichar API versioning and deprecation policy](https://docs.vichar.io/resources/api-versioning): Compatibility, deprecation notices, and sunset conventions.
- [Vichar rate limits](https://docs.vichar.io/resources/rate-limits): Quota headers and retry guidance.

- [OpenAPI specification](https://app.vichar.io/openapi.json): Machine-readable spec for the Vichar API (also at https://api.vichar.io/openapi.json). Every operation has an operationId, typed schemas, and typed 4xx/5xx error responses.
- [API base URL](https://api.vichar.io/v1): OpenAI-compatible; authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`.
- [API docs](https://docs.vichar.io): Reference and integration guides; full docs as markdown at https://app.vichar.io/llms-full.txt.
- [Quick start](https://docs.vichar.io/quick-start): First request in minutes with any OpenAI SDK.
- [MCP server](https://api.vichar.io/mcp): Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP). Connect at https://app.vichar.io/mcp or the API-domain URL. Public discovery uses GET; tool calls require an API key. OAuth metadata: https://api.vichar.io/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp.
- [API versioning](https://docs.vichar.io/resources/api-versioning): The API is path-versioned (`/v1`); breaking changes only ship under a new version. Deprecations are announced in the [changelog](https://app.vichar.io/changelog).
- [Rate limits](https://docs.vichar.io/resources/rate-limits): 429 responses include `Retry-After` and `RateLimit`, `RateLimit-Policy`, and legacy `RateLimit-*` headers; back off until `Retry-After` elapses.
